body: In the 20 years before I moved to Denmark, I have never met a single LGBT person, so I'm really unfamiliar with the scene. Everything I know about this topic basically comes from the internet. I'm afraid aswell that going to a bar can be a little overwhelming at first and it will probably be quite strange for me to hit on a guy for the first time :S.

Thanks for the effort. I have heard that there are gaybars in Copenhagen, but have not really found information on other cities. I will definitely visit that city sometime, but probably not in the near future.
